chapters: Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees bɨx gu Israeel dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Paraan gu Topel gu Labaan gu aserot gu Disaab.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch dɨr gu oreb gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk gu Seir bɨɨx ka'm gu Kades-barnea.
Ba' jix aa' ka't oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr naaka'n gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix daa gu esboon gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan jix daa gu Astarot gu Edrei.
Jano' ba' dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Moab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga bham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu oreb bham; gio ba' jix bhai'x jix duñia' dhi' gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' jix maat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu kavɨk gu Amorreo bɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' gu kavɨk saagi'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai' gu oidha' gu Kananeo gu Liibano bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix maa gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ba'k bia'ka' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tattat gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob gu kai' mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook jano' ba' bham; gio ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix bhai'x mui'kim na ja'p tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu chio'ñ mamatdagɨm pui'm na ba' tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhai' duñia' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu chio'ñ mamatdagɨm bhaan gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx mo'o mambhɨɨx gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ xibhɨk ja'tkam mii' dhɨr.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' jix ali' na ja'p jix gɨ'; na gu' cham gui'x choo'n na gu' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' kuiñcha ua'tulhi'ñ tu' tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨx dua'ñ duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oreb bɨx mii' dhɨr jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' buupui gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk gu Amorreo na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu Kades-barnea.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu Amorreo gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa vupui bhaan tu' gu oidha'; gio ba' jix duñia' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan no'ch gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt pai' jix tɨ'ɨ jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu Eskol gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu noobh gu i'bhɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aichdhak jix maa jix duñia' gui'p; gio ba' jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ va'k tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' vaak jodai vaak zel bham; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Amorreo na ba'.

Jano' ba' duukat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Nuestros gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu i'ii'ñ bham; gio ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' jix bhai'x no'ch jɨ'dɨlh vaak jodai bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr gio gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' tu' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios tu' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' oidha' jix gaki buupui gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu mar bɨx gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' tɨbiap dhi' pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx dhi' cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na ba' pai' dua'ñ yooxi' bɨɨx gu tai gu tukaa' na ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt pai' bɨɨx toov gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaam gu ñi'ook bham.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ oi'ñdha' dhi' ja'tkam dhi' gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu oidha' ka't tattat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gio bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tu' ba'k.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun vupui bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook ka't gu ma'nkam cham gu ñi'ook jix bhai' tu' cham bhai' jɨjɨkgɨm.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix maat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr no'ch jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook maa'n gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr cham tu' cham dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' cham vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook cham chɨɨdak naak; gio ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu suudai' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Amorreo jix daa mii' dhɨr gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p xoi'kam gu Seir bɨɨx ka'm gu orma.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix kai gu ñi'ook tu' naak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kades mui'x gu tanoolh na ja'p gu tanoolh jix duñia' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu Bolbimos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu Seir mui'x gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x jix duñia' dhi' gu kavɨk; gio ba' jix maat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' bhɨi gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Esauu gu Seir jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ gu ñi'ook; gu' gu ñi'ook kɇkɇɇda' jix jai'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx; na cham gu oidha' tu' gu vaas tɨɨt; na gu' tu' jix maa gu maa'nkar gu Esauu gu kavɨk gu Seir.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuumiñ koi' jugi; gio ba' gio gu suudai' i'i.
Na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh; gio ba' jiim dhi' oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam oo'm gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak; jano' ba' matgɨm tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xibhɨk gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Esauu oi'ñka' gu Seir gu bhóogɨt gu Elat gu Esiongeber; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu Moab.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moab tu' bɨɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham cham tu' gu maa'nkar gu oidha'; na gu' tu' jix maa gu Ar gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Lot.
Jano' ba' gu Emimeos jix daa va'k gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x na ja'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gio na ja'p gu Anakeos; gio ba' gu Moabitas mɨmɨim gu Emimeos.

Jano' ba' gu Seir jix daa va'k gu oreos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Esauu; gio ba' vupui bhaan pai'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p jix duu gu Israeel gu oidha' gu maa'nkar jix maa gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' jix búup jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu Sered; gio ba' jix duu gu Sered.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kades-barnea bɨɨx ka'm jix duu gu Sered jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gio gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan na ba' cham tu' duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok gu ñi'ook koi bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Moab gu Ar.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; gio ba' cham tu' bɨɨx; na gu' cham tu' no'ñ gu maa'nkar gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; na gu ma'nkam gu Lot jix maa gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook ka't gio; gio ba' jix daa gu ñi'ook gu Ammonitas tɨɨt gu Somsommeos.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x na ja'p gu Anakeos; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu Ammonitas jix daa pai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu na ja'p bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Esauu oi'ñka' gu Seir vupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oreos; gio ba' jix daa pai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ebeos oi'ñka' gu aserin bɨɨx ka'm gu Gasa gu Kaptoreos moor gu Kaptor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix daa pai'; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu Arnoon; gio ba' jix maa gu novɨ gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon gu Amorreo gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar bɨɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kua'da' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhi'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ja'tkam bɨtaa'n bɨx gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr oidha' jix gaki gu Kademot gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt tu jiim cham kɨɨ'n tu'.
Jano' ba' jugi bi'iix gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuumiñ jugi; gio ba' gu suudai' gio maa'n tuumiñ i'ya'; mi' dhɨr tɨɨt.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Esauu oi'ñka' gu Seir gu Moabitas oi'ñka' gu Ar; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu Jordaan gu oidha' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na ba' kɨɨsa' gu novɨ na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' kua'da' vupui bhaan tu' gu Seoon gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar na ba' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Seoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' gu Jaas.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho vupui bhaan no'ch; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh; gio ba' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' no'ch gu vaakax jɨ'dɨlh dua'ñ jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu Aroer ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu Arnoon kiicham bɨɨx ka'm gu Galaad cham ka't kiicham no'ch; gio ba' bɨx do'ñcho gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon cham tu' bɨx jugii'ñ jix duu gu Jabok tu' jɨ'dɨlh gu kavɨk tu' pai' oi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't.
Jano' ba' gu Bolbimos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu Basaan jix buus gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan na ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Edrei.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choo'n na gu' gu novɨ dhagia' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jix duu bɨɨx na ja'p bɨɨx gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreo jix daa gu esboon.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' cham kiicham cham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh bɨx gu oidha' gu Argob oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu Basaan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx jix bhai'x vaak jodai bɨɨx kiki'ñgob; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt mumua'da' jɨ'dɨlh cham vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon jix duñia' bɨx kiicham gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' no'ch bɨx gu vaakax jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu oidha' dɨr jix duu gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu ermoon.
Jano' ba' gu Sidonios mɨmɨim gu ermoon gu Sirioon; gio ba' gu Amorreos gu Senir; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Galaad bɨx gu Basaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Salkâ gu Edrei jɨ'dɨlh oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu Basaan.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix kavɨk jodai cham gu Rabbat gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook maakobh novɨ maa'nkar gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' dɨr gu Aroer jix duu gu Arnoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk gu Galaad bɨɨx jɨ'dɨlh tu' gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Galaad bɨx gu Basaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og tu' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees; gio ba' bɨx gu oidha' gu Argob bɨx gu Basaan tɨɨt gu oidha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jair gu mar gu Manasees jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu oidha' gu Argob bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Gessuri gu Makâti; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Basaan-abot-jair bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Makîr tu' gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' gu Rubenitas gu Gaditas tu' gu Galaad bɨɨx ka'm jix duu gu Arnoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm jix duu gu Jabok gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam gu Jordaan gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Kineret bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' jix duñia' gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado gu Pisga tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa dhi' gu oidha' na ba'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ a'aalh tu' namki' jix jai' gu vaakax jɨ'dɨlh jix maa.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gio ba' jano' ba' maa'n gu maa'nkar tu' jix maa.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu Josuee jano' ba' bham; gio ba' gu vupui bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gook gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu'.
Jano' ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; na gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' kua'da' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu novɨ jix kavɨk; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'x jai'ch gu tɨkɨr tu' gu oidha' bhaan buimɨi bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu oidha' jix bhai' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan mii' dhɨr jix bhai' gu kavɨk gu Liibano.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'x bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook kuiñcha gu ñi'ook cham jix kai; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu ñi'ook dhi'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pisga gu vupui tas gei'ñ saagi'ñ tas buusñi tu' gu vupui; na gu' cham dhi' gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Josuee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Bet-peor.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk tu' na ba' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Baal-peor; na bɨx gu chio'ñ ka't gu Baal-peor gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx ko'iix gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' ñi'ook kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix na ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' na ba' bia'ka'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam; na gu' dhi' matda' gu vupui gu ja'tkam bɨx dhi' ja'tkam ñi'ook kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam jix gɨ'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' cham tu'x jai'ch jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios mia'n na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' cham tu'x jai'ch jix duñia' ñi'ook kavɨk jir bhai' ja'tkam na ja'p bɨx dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix nukadham gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu'x gu vupui jix duñia' buupui tu' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu oreb na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨx gu tanoolh bhaan gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tai bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx gu tukgam toov gu tukgam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu' gu ñi'ook matgɨm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix aa'ñdhix tu duukam mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ua'na gook gu jodai.
Jano' ba' tu' gio jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu duukam gu oidha' na ba' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' matgɨm gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook na jax chu'm gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax ka't gu oidha' gu u'uvhig.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' gu vatop oi'ñdha' ka't gu suudai' bɨtaa'n gu oidha'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu tɨkɨr ñɨi'ñ gu tas gu masad gu si'avag bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr cham tu'; na gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨtaa'n bɨx gu tɨkɨr.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ tu' jix buusñi jix kavɨk jodai gu Ejipto na ba' gu ja'tkam gu maa'nkar na ja'p dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhaam bhaan tu' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' cham gu Jordaan tu' ba'k jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu maa'nkar.
Na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi dhi' gu oidha'; gio ba' cham gu Jordaan; gu' bia'ka' mii' dhɨr jix bhai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' kɇkɇɇda' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios dhi' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na jax chu'm gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu oidha' tu' na jax chu'm tu' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu Yo jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' jootom gu oidha' bhaan gu Jordaan na ba' bia'ka'; gio ba' cham dhi' jix duñia' gu tanoolh cham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨɨ'ñdhidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu noobh gu chichio'ñ gu u'u gu jodai cham tu' kua'da' tu'.
Gu' gu' tu' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bakia' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx dhi' tu'x tu' gu tanoolh tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham tu' kiicha' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x ñi'ook na jix bhaan tattat gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' tu ñi'ook jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' va'k tu' dɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ bhaan gu oidha' dɨr gu tɨkɨr tu' gu ñi'ook nɨidhim dhi' ka't naak na ja'p.
Jano' ba' tu' naak gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai na ja'p tu' naak jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix duu tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ai jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bɨɨx buimɨk bɨɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx tu'x bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch mai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tɨkɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba'; gio ba' bhaan gu oidha' tu' gu tai; mi' dhɨr naak gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' jix buusñi vupui bhaan gu Ejipto bɨɨx.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' chɨbɨɨp jix kavɨk tu' na ba' gu oidha' gu maa'nkar na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jiix gu tɨkɨr bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch.

Jano' ba' jix nukadham ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr tu' gu tanoolh bhaan gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu Moisees vaik jɨ'dɨlh dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas.
Na ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook mua'kam gu ñi'ook tɨtmo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia' bɨɨx dɨr gu ñi'ook tu' va'k gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh dodhia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Beser oidha' jix gaki gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rubenitas; gio ba' gu Ramot gu Galaad gu Gaditas; mi' dhɨr gu Golaan gu Basaan gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto.

Na pai' dhuuk dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Bet-peor gu oidha' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix daa gu esboon naaka'n gu Moisees bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan; gio ba' gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu tas.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu Aroer ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu Sioon gu ermoon.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Pisga.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Moisees bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel ñi'ook kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook maatɨt; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx no'ch gu oreb.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bɨɨx taata'n tattat gu Jawatan Dios dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook ko'iix.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu ñi'ook choo'n gu tai cham gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr bham.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na jax chu'm jiix gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu suudai' bɨtaa'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook tattat bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan gu tanoolh bhaan jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jɨɨpi'ñka' na ba' jix bhaan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jix duu bɨx gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' kɨɨv jɨɨpi'ñka' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook jix duu tu' gu mar tu' mar u'vɨ tu' tu duukam tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios tu' gu vaakax tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob; na gu' tu duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios na ja'p tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu tanoolh jɨɨpi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' gu onra gu taat gu naan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' na ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' cham koo'nda'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' cham bɨɨna'.
Jano' ba' cham daipu' ɨɨxi'ñdha' chuut bhaan tɨtmo.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ tɨtmo tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak tɨtmo tu' gu oidha' tu' tu duukam tu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios tu' gu vaakax tu' gu ñi'ook tu' matgɨm ka't tɨtmo.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai toov gu tukgam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ua'na gook gu jodai jix maa tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tukgam gu kavɨk gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tai tu' bɨx chiñia' bopxi'ñ daraa.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' naak gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook buupui gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook koi dhi' gu tai; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios koi.
Jano' ba' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chuukug na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig tu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai na ja'p no'ch gu tai.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx tu'x tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' daipu' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook no'ch chulhiiñchuda'.

Na pai' dhuuk jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr naak gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx jix duñia' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu tanoolh bɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ma'nkam jum duu gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vaak zel.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook jano' tu duukam gu oidha' tu' na ba' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' cham kɨɨ'n tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' na ba' xoi'kam jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu oidha' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook na ba' tu duukam gu oidha' na ba' bia'ka'.
Na ba' na ba' jum i'obh gu Jawatan Dios nukadham bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu mar bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu tanoolh ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Israeel jix duñia' tu duukam na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu oidha' bii'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook no'm bhaan gu i'ii'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam tu ñi'ook kua' gu vaak jiim gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk tu' jix búup.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨi'ñchudat gu novɨ no'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tattat gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob tu'; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix bhai' tu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu vaak jix bhuup bɨx jix bhai' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham oidha' u'va cham gu ux na tu ibai'; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jum i'obh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' ñi'ook kavɨk aa'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu' bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham vaak zel gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p vaak zel gu Massa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook kavɨk tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tattat.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu xibh tu' tu ñi'ook gu mar bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daipu' gu mar; gio ba' no'ch jɨɨ'ñdhat tu duukam gu Faraoon gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios buimɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto bhaan gu Faraoon bhaan bɨx gu vaak vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook taata'n tattat.

Na gu' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' ja'tkam ñi'ook kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na gu' xoi'kam bɨx gu tanoolh na ba' jix maa gu oidha' na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai' na pai' dhuuk tu duukam bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p tu' jix duñia'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' tu' baakɨi na ba' bia'ka' bhɨɨya' baas vupui bhaan tu' mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp gu eteo gu Gergeseo gu Amorreo gu Kananeo gu Pereseo gu ebeo gu Jebuseo kɨɨv gu ja'tkam jix kavɨk tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' dhagia' vupui bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; gio ba' cham jix duu bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx; gio ba' cham maa'n mar u'vɨ gu mar tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim mar u'vɨ na ba' gu mar.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar tu' tu juan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' tu jiim jootom.
Gu' gu' jix duñia' duñia' bɨɨx; gio ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tai.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu'; na gu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Na gu' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nukadham gu ñi'ook tattat tu' jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk tu' gu vaak tu duukam gu novɨ gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix nukadham ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jix bhai'x gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaamki'ñ; gio ba' tu' maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix nukadham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak dhi' ja'tkam tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios nukadham bɨndak ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook tattat.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix bhai' aa' tu' jix mui' jix bhai' aa' gu i'bhɨ vook gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' kai'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu' kakneer gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tattat tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka' bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham tu' gu chio'ñ tu' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook tu' gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨx ko'kdai'; gio ba' bɨx gu Ejipto tu' ñɨidhat cham bhaan tu' va'k bhaan bɨx tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam tu' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham uañi'ñka' gu vupui; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' dhi' chɨbɨɨp mumua'da' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choo'n; gio ba' xoi'kam jix duu gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Faraoon bɨɨx bɨx gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui buimɨk gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam tu'.
Jano' ba' gio gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' na jix uam vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook na gu' gu vaakax yooxi' cham bhaan tu'.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' vupui bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm ka't.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu gɨ'kora' gu novɨ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' soo'mchulhdhak tu' jix bhai'x bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tai; na gu' cham jix toja jodai tu' jix uam jodai bhaan na ba' jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu' na gu' cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu vaak na gu' cham na ja'p; gio ba' bɨx; na gu'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook pai' tu' gu Jawatan Dios dhi' ja'tkam oo'm oidha' jix gaki na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' maachim ka't gu i'ii'ñ tu' nukadham cham gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' mambhɨɨx bhiogi' tu' bɨɨx jugi cham tu' tattat; na ba' maachim gu chio'ñ cham ii'mdagaram gu takarui' gu' bɨx gu chin gu Jawatan Dios ii'mdagaram gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' tɨi'chu' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' tɨɨt tu' dhi' ja'tkam oo'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu mar gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' gu oidha' gu suudai' suudai' buusñi gɇ' suudai' jix duñia' gu kakkavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' tiriik kai' vaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' cham jugi gu takarui' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' cham tu'; gio ba' gu oidha' gu jodai jix kavɨk jodai gu kakkavɨk jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jugi tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' gu oidha' tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios na ba' cham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jugi tu' jix bhai' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer jix toja jodai jix uam jodai tu' bɨx tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu' jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu ko'oi gu ñi'ook pai' gu suudai' ka't tu' jix buusñi gu suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam.
Na tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx oidha' jix gaki jugi tattat cham na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu novɨ jix duñia' dhi'.
Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' jix maa na ba' gu ñi'ook namkɨm gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ñi'ook tattat na ja'p dhi' gu tanoolh.
Gu' gu' ka't tu' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook tɨɨda'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan na ba' baakɨi gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp jix kavɨk tu' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' jix bhai'x gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' machia' naak; gio ba' chɨkka vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' gu tai jix duñia' tu jiim jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' tu' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios baas vupui bhaan tu' bham; gio ba' bɨx bhai' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook dhi' gu oidha'; na gu' dhi' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gu' gu ñi'ook dhi' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tattat gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa dhi' jix bhai' gu oidha' na ba' bia'ka'; na gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x tu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x daak gu Jawatan Dios oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' dɨr gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm ba'k dhi' pai' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu oreb gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' cham tu' duu.

Jano' ba' jix duu na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk na ba' gu jodai ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jano' ba' gu kavɨk oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa' cham jugi gu takarui' tu' i'i gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai ua'ñix bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't ua'nak jurtu'nka' bɨx gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai gu tanoolh bɨx ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gook gu jodai ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bamii' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jootom; na gu ja'tkam jix buusñi gu Ejipto tu'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt tu'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' buupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr; na tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tai bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan gook gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dua'ñ uañi'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dua'ñ gu ñi'ook tuur jootom gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu noobh vupui bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p va'k oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa'; gio ba' cham gu takarui' tu' gu suudai' kuiñcha bɨx uañi'ñ dua'ñ gu vupui cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ba'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha i'iich daak bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhai'x bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' cham tu' duu; gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix kai dhi' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu Aaroon gio bhaam gu Jawatan Dios na ba' cham tu' duu; gio ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ tuur dua'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tai gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm ka't oo'; gio ba' oo' jix duu tɨmñim gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gio gu Tabera gu Massa gu Kibrot-ataaba gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios bhañ dɨr gu Kades-barnea bham gu Subid bia'ka' gu oidha' tu' jix maa; gio ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu tanoolh tu' kakasnira'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' ka't cham tu' duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ja'tkam gu maa'nkar bɨɨx jix buusñi gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob; gio ba' cham dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' uañi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' pai' jix buusñi; na gu' cham gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' ka't tu ñi'ook na gu' jix buusñi na ba' kooda' pai' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu maa'nkar jix buusñi bɨɨx gu kavɨk bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu jodai na ja'p tumiiñku jix duñia' tu' gu kavɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu u'u.
Jano' ba' ua'na' mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mi'p tumiiñku; gio ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu u'u gu Sittim gook gu jodai na ja'p tumiiñku gu kavɨk bɨɨx gook gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' ua'na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' gu'p mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai gu tanoolh bɨx ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Beerot-bene-jakaam gu Moseraa; gio ba' jix koi gu Aaroon ka't jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu mar gu Eleasar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Gudgod gu Jotbat gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix ai'chdhix gu Jawatan Dios bopxi'ñ gu Lebii na ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu duu na ba' jix bhai' aa' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebii cham jix duñia' baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk na ja'p dharka' gu tanoolh oo'm gu tanoolh oo'm gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gio dhi' jix duñia' cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bamii' jiim na ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam na ba' kapbhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat ka't.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook jum i'obh gu Jawatan Dios jiim bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na nukadham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook kavɨk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' cham tu'x jai'ch xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu oidha' bɨx tu'x cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tattat gu Jawatan Dios na ba' xoi'kam gu kai' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam na ja'p dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu Kirkunkidad gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ cham moimkada' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhɨɨ.
Na duñia' bɨx bhai' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam; na xoi'kam gio ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' tɨi'chu'.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ja'tkam mii' dhɨr; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jum i'obh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' ñi'ook kavɨk aa'.
Jano' ba' bhai' ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bɨndak dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'x gu vupui jix duñia' buupui.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ jix dhaav tattat gu Ejipto; gio ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bɨx bhai' ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; na gu' cham chɨɨdaim bɨɨx gu ma'nkam cham jix duñia' tu' buupui sɨlhka'n gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu buimɨk buimɨi tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ejipto gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto bɨx gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jix duu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Ejipto kavaayo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jix duu gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo bhaan na pai' dhuuk aajidha' bhaan mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi' pai'.

Jano' ba' jix duu bɨɨx gu Dataan gu Abiram gu ma'nkam gu Eliab gu mar gu Rubeen; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix kupi'ook gu oidha' gu chin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak vaak zel bɨx ko'kmarak tɨɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu vupui jix duñia' buupui bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu oidha' na ba' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' na ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh bhaan gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat ka't gu kai' gu oidha' bii'm gu ñi'ook.
Na gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bia'ka' cham na ja'p gu oidha' gu Ejipto pai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook pai' gu kai' bɨɨx tɨɨt na ja'p u'uu pai'.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bia'ka' gu oidha' gu kakkavɨk; gio ba' dhuuk gu tɨkɨr tu' i'i gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨɨx tas bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios dɨr bɨɨpɨ' oi'ñga' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhuuk gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na jix bhai'; gio ba' kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu vaas yooxi' na ba' gu vaakax; gio ba' jugi tu'.
Jano' ba' kɇkɇɇda' gu i'ii'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr cham ka't dhuuk tu' gu oidha' jix maa gu i'bhɨ jootom jix bhai' gu oidha' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ nɨi'ñchudat gu novɨ ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam a'gi'ñchu' daakat gu vaak jiim gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk tu' na pai' dhuuk tu' jix búup.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak.
Na ba' na ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu ma'nkam bhaan gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat ka't na ja'p gu tanoolh gu tɨkɨr bhaan gu oidha'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu' na ba'; gio ba' na ja'p kai'chɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook bia'ka' chɨbɨɨp jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaas tɨɨt ka't; gio ba' dɨr oidha' jix gaki gu Liibano dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' soo'mchulhdhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ɨɨbhi'ñ choo'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha' na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook mu'ai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mu'ai tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' na ba' bia'ka' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu kavɨk gu Gerisim mu'ai bhaan gu kavɨk gu Ebal.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan bhaan gu bhóogɨt tas gei'ñ gu oidha' gu Kananeo jix daa vaak ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Gilgal ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu More.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jordaan na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam ñi'ook kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' jix maa na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Destruireeis jix duñia' bɨx pai' chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu kakkavɨk gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨtaa'n bɨx gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨɨx gu tai; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bopxi'ñ na ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' ba'bhak tui'ka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' boosgi gu maa'nkar gu noobh maa'nkar na jix maa kakneer.
Jano' ba' jugi vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu duukam gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p bɨx no'ch jano' maa'n gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm jano' cham jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ jɨɨpi'ñka' gu maa'nkar jix maa gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook maa'n jɨɨpi'ñka' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ xikoolh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx tu'x tu'; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' boosgi maa'nkar na jix maa gu noobh bɨx jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ tu duukam gu Lebita; na gu' cham juraa'n baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham maa'nkar tai bhaan pai'.
Gu' gu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan jix duu bɨx tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kooda' jugi gu chuukug bɨx jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa; gio ba' ñaanbi' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr cham jugi; gio ba' bhaan gu oidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ja'p gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi mambhɨɨx kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' tu' kakneer tu' maa'nkar na jix maa tu' maa'nkar na jix maa gu noobh.

Gu' gu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jugi pai' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu mar mar u'vɨ tu duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu Lebita; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx tu duukam gu noobh.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebita bɨx gu tanoolh bhaan gu oidha'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook tu' gu Komeree gu chuukug na gu' jix duu gu i'ii'ñ jugi jurtu'nka' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ jugi gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' koo'nda' kakneer gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' jix maa na ja'p tu' jix duñia' tu' jugi kiki'ñgob bhaan bɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jugi; gio ba' ñaanbi' jugi gio.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham jugi gu ɨ'ɨr; na gu' gu ɨ'ɨr gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham jugi gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' cham jugi; gio ba' gu oidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ja'p gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' cham jugi; na pai' dhuuk na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr tu' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ɨlhdham pai' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu chuukug gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr makgɨrxi'ñdha' ka't bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jugi gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk jix nukadham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas na pai' dhuuk jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam pai' tu' na ba' bia'ka' gu ñi'ook jix daa gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham mi' dhɨr ua'tulhi'ñ vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr tu juan mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios tu' gio.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios bhaamki'ñ jix duu gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ñi'ook gu tai gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' bɨx tu'; gio ba' cham tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tɨɨtki' tu' nɨi'ñchudat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨi'ñchudat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham.

Jano' ba' cham maa'n naak gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨtki'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' maachim tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨtki' tu' jix koi; na gu' uañi'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto tu' gu vaak tu duukam gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix; mi' dhɨr cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xibhɨk gu mar gu naan gu mar mar u'vɨ gu u'vɨ baaso ka't na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ bham ɨxchuixim; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tattat.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam xikoolh mia'n tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dɨr gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tu' maa'n naak; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñka' tu' jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' va'k kooda'; gio ba' gu novɨ ka't maa'n bhaan na ba' mu'aa' mi' dhɨr gu novɨ bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu jodai koi; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam.
Na ba' na ba' bɨx gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tema cham nɨidhim dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa na ba' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix duñia' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n kiicham bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu'r dhuu jix duñia' jix duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr kiicham bɨɨx bɨx bhɨɨya' gio gu vaakax gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨrban bɨɨx gu tai kiicham bɨx gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't gɨ' kavɨk na ba' bɨɨx tas; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu novɨ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios dɨlhkob i'iich daak tu' jix maa jix duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' na ja'p tattat.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan gu vupui jix koi.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' na ba' gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan gu vupui gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu vaakax jugi; gio ba' gu vaakax kaneer gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiiw dodhia' gu vaakax dodhia' chiiw gɨ' kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax gu ñi'ook juraa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax jugi.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook dhi' ja'tkam cham jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namki' gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix ai na gu' gu' cham namki' gu ñi'ook ka't jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu' cham ka't ñaanbi'; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug suulhgia' cham jugi tu' kuichdha' gu chuukug koko'kam.
Jano' ba' dhi' jugi bɨx gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨx juraa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim jugi.
Gu' gu' bɨx cham palhɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim cham jugi; gio ba' ñaanbi' ka't.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu u'uvhig na jix bhai' jugi.
Jano' ba' dhi' cham jugi; gio ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Asor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan na jax chu'm vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ko'oi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' cham jugi.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu u'uvhig na jix bhai' jugi.

Jano' ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi; gio ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr maa'n jugi; mi' dhɨr ja'tkam mii' dhɨr; na gu' tu' gu ja'tkam jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham chiiw bii'm gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx bɨx gu kai' yooxi' oi'ñga'.
Jano' ba' jugi vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu vupui gu tɨɨgɨ' mambhɨɨx kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu vaakax na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh.

Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu bhóogɨt ua'tulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' na ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bi'iix gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuumiñ gu novɨ ɨlhdham pai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'n tuumiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ kakneer suudai' u'va gu i'ii'ñ tu'; gio ba' jugi vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebita; na gu' cham juraa'n baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik jix buusñi bɨx mambhɨɨx mii' dhɨr oi'ñga' jɨ'dɨlh.

Jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu Lebita cham juraa'n baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar bɨndak ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi ka't; na ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv jix duu.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' uañi'ñka' bɨx jix duu gu novɨ bɨɨx tɨtmo; mi' dhɨr cham tɨtmo xibhɨk; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' xibhɨk palhɨɨp uañi'ñka' gu novɨ.
Na ba' na ba' cham ka't tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai' aa' bɨɨx gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu maa'nkar na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' nukadham bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook jano' ba' mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp gu' tu' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp gu' tu' cham.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' tu' gu ja'tkam oi'ñdha' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa cham gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu novɨ xibhɨk gampai'.
Gu' gu' bhi'spio'kai gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhɨɨya'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x bham; gio ba' mia'n oi'ñga' kɨɨv; mi' dhɨr gu vupui ka't bhaan xibhɨk gu ja'tkam na ba' cham nukadham; na tu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' uañi'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk cham uañi'ñ maa'n cham ka't gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk; na tu' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu novɨ.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' bham; mi' dhɨr bhi'spio'kai gu novɨ xibhɨk gampai' gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' xibhɨk gu ebreo gu ebrea tu' bhɨɨya' jix duñia' kɨɨv oi'ñga' namkidhat tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namkidhat tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer ka't; gio ba' maa'n mii' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Jawatan Dios tu'; na ba' tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak; na gu' tu' xoi'kam tu' gu vaak tu' xoi'kam bɨndak.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak ju'ñdharan ki'ñgob ka't tu duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gio jix duu gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x na pai' dhuuk tɨip namkidhat tu'; na tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai' aa' bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu chio'ñ kakneer; gio ba' cham tu' bhaan kakneer.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jugi oi'ñga' tu' ja'tkam vaak pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' tu' bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bai'ñchu' jix bhai'x no'x uañi'ñ cham maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi; gio ba' ñaanbi' jugi na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' bhaan gu oidha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ja'p gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abib jix duu gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Abib tu' jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios kakneer gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' cham jugi bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi bɨɨx gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' na gu' jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na ba' tu' gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨx gu tanoolh pai'.
Jano' ba' cham kiicha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jabka' bɨndak bɨx gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu chuukug kooda' gu xumai maa'n gu tanoolh cham bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' gakdhi'ñchix matgɨm jɨ'dɨlh gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Gu' gu ñi'ook pai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix gu xumai jix duñia' gu tas gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi pai' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya'; gio ba' gu xibh tu' jix maat gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jugi kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' dɨr kua'da' kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu novɨ ka't bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya'.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu mar mar u'vɨ tu duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu Lebita jɨ'dɨlh ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' na ba' gu vupui gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu Ejipto; na ba' dhi' ja'tkam ñi'ook kavɨk.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu kɨɨv gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' ka't.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu mar mar u'vɨ tu duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu Lebita ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu i'bhɨ bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh dhi' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu Tres mui'kim oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios pai'; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'n bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Jawatan Dios tu' maa'n bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨɨx jir bhai' ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham tu' jix bhɨɨ gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ; na gu' gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu vupui mamatdagɨm gu ñi'ook jir bhai' ja'tkam.
Na gu' bɨx bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' na jix do'ig gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu ux na tu ibai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u mia'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi'; gio ba' bhaamki'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu vaakax mar kaneer ka't uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bakia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ ka't gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Na bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨya' jix duñia' gu tas gu masad bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr tu' cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ jix maa aa'ñdham mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu'r dhuu jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buusñi gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx gu jodai koi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gook vaik koi bhɨɨya' koi; gio ba' cham koi tu ñi'ook ñi'ookdham.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't maa'n bhaan na ba' kooda' mi' dhɨr gu novɨ bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ua'tulhi'ñ ñi'ook na jir bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ kuiñcha tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu jiim jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' jano' ba' tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ɨlhdham jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas jir bɨx bhai' ua'tulhi'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios duñia' bhaan bɨx tu'.
Jano' ba' bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan ñi'ook na jir bhai' tu' tu ñi'ook jix duu; gio ba' cham tu' kɨɨ'n tu'.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx cham jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jir bɨx bhai' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ koi; gio ba' cham bhai' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jix daa tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan tu' na ja'p bɨx chɨbɨɨp xikoolh.

Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr cham jix dhaas bhaan tu' gu chio'ñ ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham ka't xibhɨk.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo tu' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Ejipto na ba' kavaayo; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook dhi' gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu u'vɨ na gu' gu i'ii'ñ cham; gio ba' tu' jix toja jodai tu' jix uam jodai na ba'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' u'uan bhaan dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baidhak bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' nukadham bɨx gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga dhi' ja'tkam ñi'ook kavɨk na ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu duukam.
Na ba' na ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bhaan gu ja'tkam tu' dɨlhkob gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'n tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Lebii cham jix duñia' baasɨ'n tu' gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar jugi.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan baasɨ'n gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu vaakax mar kaneer; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' kakneer maa'n.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bopxi'ñ na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Lebita gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh bɨx gu Israeel pai' bhɨɨya' daraibu' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ pai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p jugi.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa cham bhaan mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gaagam tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu mar mar u'vɨ gu tai tu' jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' tu' koko'kam.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios no'x duñia' dhi' tu'x dhi' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' dhi' chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' tu' cham tu' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ja'tkam na ja'p tu' jix búup gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu oreb gu tanoolh bɨx ja'tkam bham; na gu' cham jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhi' gu tai na gu' cham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam na ja'p tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chin tu ñi'ook bɨx tu'.
Gu' gu' ka't no'x cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñiokda' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' cham ka't jix duñia' ñiokda' tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan koi.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham bhɨɨya' tu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham ua'tulhi'ñ jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' daraibu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'; gio ba' bɨɨx tu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr cham choo'n.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa tu' gu ñi'ook jix daa jɨ'dɨlh gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik jɨ'dɨlh tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt vaik gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' maa'n gu maa'nkar ka't na ba' bɨx mua'kam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mua'kam tu' ii'mdagaram; na gu ñi'ook tɨtmo cham ga'ra' dɨr gu ñi'ook tu' va'k gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't bɨɨx tɨtmo gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu u'u gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk bɨɨx gu novɨ gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk jodai tɨtmo jix koi; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh ii'mdagaram.

Na pai' dhuuk cham ka't jir bɨx bhai' jix koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mua'kam na pai' dhuuk gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt koi'm cham koi'm; na gu' cham ga'ra' dɨr gu ñi'ook tu' va'k gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix koi.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bham; gio ba' vaik jɨ'dɨlh tu'.
Ba' jix aa' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook tattat tu' bɨx gu oidha' tattat ka't.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk nuuka'n bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu tanoolh; gio ba' jano' ba' vaik jɨ'dɨlh dhi' vaik.
Na gu' na gu' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu maa'nkar ka't bhaan tu' gu ɨ'ɨr.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtmo bhaan gu ñi'ook koi'm vaak jodai dhi' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa kiicham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨsa' jix duñia' gu novɨ jir bɨx bhai' jix koi koi.
Jano' ba' cham uañi'ñka' gu vupui; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu ɨ'ɨr tu' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨtmo nɨi'ñchudat gu maa'nkar gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ookdham bhaan uañi'ñ; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gook vaik.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ookdham ɨɨxi'ñdha' bhaan oi'ñdha' na ba' bhaan uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gook gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan ua'tulhi'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' ñi'ookdham ɨɨxi'ñdha' bhaan xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p duñia' xibhɨk; gio ba' cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham duñia' na ja'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' cham uañi'ñka' gu vupui; gio ba' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu vupui taatam gu novɨ tɨɨt.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ kavaayo gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' tu' cham choo'n gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak tu' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' cham tu' vupui bhaan.
Na gu Jawatan Dios jiim bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ na ba' dodhia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bham; na gu' chɨkka tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak cham tu' gu Baya gu vaak na gu' cham oi'ñdha'.
Na gu' chɨkka tu' gu ux na tu ibai' oidha' u'va cham tu' gu ñi'ook kua'dam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baya gu vaak na gu' cham oi'ñdha'.
Na gu' chɨkka tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ cham tu' jix duñia' gu Baya gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na gu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ñiokda' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' chɨkka gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ gu Baya gu vaak cham gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook ñiokda' gu ja'tkam jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chugi'ñ vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' gu ñi'ook kiicham na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' tu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam ua'tulhi'ñ gaagam tu' ka't bopxi'ñ tu' tu juan.
Gu' gu' tu' cham jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨndak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak bhɨɨ'ñdham mia'n.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chio'ñ gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu vaakax bɨx bhɨɨya' kiicham bɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba' tu'; gio ba' jugi obhɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' do'ñcho.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt tu' cham ua'tulhi'ñ jɨ'dɨlh dhi' chɨbɨɨp.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh dhi' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar matgɨm gu ñi'ook kiicha' bɨɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' va'k bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu eteo gu Amorreo gu Kananeo gu Pereseo gu ebeo gu Jebuseo; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' cham jix maat duñia' bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' kiicham bhaan mui'x gu tanoolh na ba' jix bhɨɨ cham gu ñi'ook na gu' jugi; gio ba' cham gu chio'ñ gu u'u yooxi' na ba' jix ai bhaan tu' jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' gu u'u gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu u'u na ba' jugi bhaan kiicham bɨndak bɨɨx ka'm jix gɨ'kora'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ua'tulhi'ñ gaagam gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa na ba' gu ñi'ook jix koi baas yooxi' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨkka naaka'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jɨ'dɨlh xikoolh jix koi.
Jano' ba' ka't daraa mii' dhɨr kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mia'n jix koi jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook cham ka't jix duñia' cham ka't.
Jano' ba' daraa mii' dhɨr kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x cham pai' dhuuk ka't jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' jano' ba' aajim jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Lebii na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix bhai' aa' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx tu jiim.
Jano' ba' bɨx daraa mii' dhɨr kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mia'n jix koi jix duñia' gu noobh bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu novɨ gu noobh cham jix duñia' vaak na jix bhaan dhi' gu ɨ'ɨr tu' gu novɨ gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu ɨ'ɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak; gio ba' mo'o.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨi'chu' gu vaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu naan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ba'k ka' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ.
