Jano' ba' ka't tu' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' cham bi'iix tuumiñ tu' bɨɨx na gu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ palhɨɨp gook gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu mar maa'nkam mar ua'tulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam palhɨɨp cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu mar maa'nkam mar.
Gu' gu' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkam mar na ba' jix maa gook bɨx bakia' juraa'n; na gu' bɨɨpɨ' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' palhɨɨp gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook gu taat tu' gu ñi'ook gu naan cham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu taat gu naan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daraa kiicham ki'ñgob pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daraa kiicham; gio ba' dhi' chulhiiñdha' gu mar cham gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu chichio'ñ kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu jodai koi; gio ba' cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' bhɨɨya' uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi'm gu ñi'ook ka't koi jix duu.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug gu tukaa' jix duu gu' cham uañi'ñ gu tanoolh na gu' mu'ai gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax xibhɨk mar kaneer tu'; gio ba' jix maat xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' tu' xibhɨk cham ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu vaak no'm bɨndak bɨɨx ka'm xibhɨk jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gio tɨi'chu' bɨɨx bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n xibhɨk jix duñia' tu' bakia'; gio ba' cham.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook xibhɨk gu vaakax gu bhóogɨt tu'; gio ba' bɨɨx jix búup.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ tu' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios no'x dhi' duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu u'uvhig gu u'u bhaan gu oidha' bɨɨx gu naan jix duñia' bhaan cham jix bhɨɨ gu naan bɨɨx gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' kiicha' tu' gu naan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu'; na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu na gu' cham gu ɨ'ɨr gu vaak tu' oi'ñdha'.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' u'va gu kai' na gu' cham gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu kai' gu i'bhɨ oidha' u'va.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu vaakax bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨma'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh bɨɨx tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kia'mi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' gu u'vɨ cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu naan jix bhɨɨ buimɨk gu ñi'ook daraa kiicham ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat daraa; gio ba' tu' mar u'vɨ dhi' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ bhaamki'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas tu'x bham; gio ba' cham gaagam mar u'vɨ gu ñi'ook; gu' cham gu ñi'ook buimɨk gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ; jano' ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan daraa kiicham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa kiicham jix bhɨɨ gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai gu taat na gu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' mambhɨɨx gu u'vɨ cham bɨx gu tanoolh.
Gu' gu' tu' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tu'r cham bhɨɨya' gaagam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob gu vaak gu taat bɨɨx gu jodai gu chichio'ñ kiicham koi; na gu' jix duu gu Israeel gu vaak gu taat; mi' dhɨr cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñdha' baas bɨɨx gu u'vɨ bɨɨx gu chio'ñ ba'k koi gu chio'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ; gio ba' cham bhai' gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx oi'ñdha' bakia' kiicham bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob mii' dhɨr kiicham bɨɨx gu jodai koi; na gu' cham jix maa jiiñak kiicham gu chio'ñ na gu' gu u'vɨ tɨtmo; mi' dhɨr cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook yooxi' bɨɨx koi gu chio'ñ bɨɨx baas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duu cham tu'; gio ba' cham juraa'n gu ñi'ook koi'm; na pai' dhuuk na gu' na ja'p na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' jix búup bhaan tɨtmo gu oidha' dhi'.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook yooxi'; gio ba' jix maa jiiñak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' bakia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham ua'tulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx ua'tulhi'ñ bakia'.
Na gu' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx maa'n gu taat mambhɨɨx jix toja jodai ka't gu u'vɨ na gu'; gio ba' cham bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñdha' gu u'vɨ gu taat tu' gu taat.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ammonita tu' gu Moabita gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Na pai' dhuuk na gu' cham moor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu takarui' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk oirɨ gu Ejipto; na gu' bhaan tu' gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor gu Petor gu Mesopotamia gu Siria na ba' tu'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' tu' oi'ñdha' cham ua'tulhi'ñ na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukaa' yooxi' cham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' mai' vaak ja'tkam mai'.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' na ba' jix duñia' kɨɨsa' vupui bhaan tu'; na ba' ka't vaak ja'tkam jix bhaan; na gu' cham tu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix duñia' tu'.
Jano' ba' cham kapbhai' gu Jawatan tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ganai' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Israeel tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim xibhɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuumiñ tu' jugi tu'.

Na gu' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' xibhɨk cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx tu duukam gu noobh bhaan gu oidha' na ba' bia'ka'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' uañi'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk baakɨi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtmo kaipgaidhat bɨɨx gu novɨ; gu' cham tɨtmo.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gaagam gu ñi'ook kapbhai' gu novɨ gu vaak.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim oi'ñdha' gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhɨɨ'ñdham tu' matgɨm; gio ba' namkidhat gu vaak oi'ñga' na ba' jix duñia' gu u'vɨ jix bhɨɨ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Mariia gu bhóogɨt mi' dhɨr oirɨ gu Ejipto.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtmo cham ba'k gu vaak na ba' jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' mai' dhi' gu chio'ñ jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu chio'ñ gampai' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu tas jix duñia' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' tu' ka't bɨx bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gampai' gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu oidha' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu tas cham; na gu' gampai' bɨɨx jix duñia' gu oidha'; na gu' cham tu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tattat cham koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam tu' gu ma'nkam tattat; gio ba' maa'n koi uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam; gio ba' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu Ejipto tu' gu Jawatan Dios; na ba' tu' dhi'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x yooxi' cham jix maat jix bhɨɨ; na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr na ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam na ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam ka't; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham mamraga'n bhaan tu'; na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr na ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam na ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu'; na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr na ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam na ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na ba' tu' dhi'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' gu oidha' jix maat vupui bhaan bhaan jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix maat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm cham; gio ba' cham ka't tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx mui'x suulhgia' xibhɨk vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Na pai' dhuuk cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu vaakax na pai' dhuuk.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtda:―Aañ vaak jodai oi'ñdha' cham palhɨɨp gu mar gu u'vɨ jix koi cham mai' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu tanoolh na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ bɨɨx.
Na gu' ka't maa'nkam mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup gu tɨɨgɨ' xibhɨk jix koi na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' cham ka't gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' tu' gu chio'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' ki'ñgob daraa; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' cham gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Israeel xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr cham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa mii' dhɨr kiicham jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook bɨɨx; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' vupui bhaan daraa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt gu vupui tu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ cham gu vaak xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't tɨɨgim gu Israeel; gio ba' gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk dhɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtda:―Aañ maa'n bɨɨx gu u'vɨ maa'n na ba' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jano' ba' gu novɨ cham uañi'ñka' gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bhai'; gio ba' gu Epa jix duñia' jir bhai'; na ba' gu tanoolh ka't bhaan gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios no'x duñia' dhi' no'x duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Amalek gu bhóogɨt na pai' dhuuk oirɨ gu Ejipto.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' obhɨɨ'ñ xikoolh gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar na ba' gu ñi'ook chɨ'ñchoka' gu Amalek bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' cham tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu maa'nkar jix daa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa tu' pai' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ua'tulhi'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh daipu'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios taata'n tattat ka't.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook daipu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Siro gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi ka't gu taat jix dhaav gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Egipkios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas bhaan no'ch juantu'n.

Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto bɨɨx gu novɨ jix kavɨk bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx buimɨk bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' pai' jix maa dhi' gu oidha' bii'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' chɨɨdak gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' kiicha' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' jix maa tu' gu vaak tu' gu Lebita ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx bɨx mambhɨɨx gu i'bhɨ oi'ñga' vaik oi'ñga' mambhɨɨx maa'n gio gu Lebita ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam; gio ba' jugi jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' daipu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Yo jix buusñi jix bhaan gu vaak gio jix maa gu Lebita ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam jurtu'nka' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr cham bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' ka't gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jiim gu bhóogɨt na ba' nukadham ñi'ook kavɨk gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp na ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' na ba' gu ja'tkam jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu jodai jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai bɨx gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees bɨɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bham.

Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ja'tkam no'm bhaan gu kavɨk gu Gerisim na ba' jix bhai' aa' gu ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu Simeoon gu Lebii gu Judaa tu' gu Issakâr gu Josee gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat gu naan; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨtmo; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bai'ñchu' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu taat; na gu' jix ñi'ñ gu taat; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam palhɨɨp baasɨ'n bɨɨx no'x gu vaakax; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ja'tkam mar u'vɨ gu taat mar u'vɨ gu naan; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bakxidhat; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨtmo; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam alhii na ba' gu ñi'ook koi'm; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga na ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai'; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' nukadham na ba' tu duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gio gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai'x bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk aajim bhaan tu' bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka' tu' kiicham tu' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'bhɨ vook gu i'bhɨ gu vaakax kakneer.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka' baakɨi jix buus.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios obhɨɨ'ñ bhaan tu' vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak gu ñi'ook bɨx mii' dhɨr gu novɨ; gio ba' tu' jix bhai' aa' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Na pai' dhuuk gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix bhaan na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk nukadham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨgim bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios daam xoi'kam gu i'bhɨ vook gu i'bhɨ gu vaakax gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat tu' ka't.

Jano' ba' bhi'spio'kai tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhuuk gu oidha' gu ñi'ook na ba' jix bhai' aa' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh; gio ba' mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp tu' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios mo'o cham; gio ba' dhi' tu jiim cham dhi' bɨtaa'n; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' nukadham.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' kɨɨ'n tu' na ba' tu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu juan.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook aajim bhaan tu' bɨx dhi' tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka' kiicham yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'bhɨ vook gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' kakneer.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka' baakɨi jix buus.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' mu'ai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu novɨ tu' bɨɨx ka'm jootom kuiñcha gu ñi'ook buimɨi tɨtda:―Cha'pim.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx ka'm tu' jix duñia' gu oidha' na ba' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daada'n jix tónom bɨɨx; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu tɨkɨr bhaan mo'o ka't gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' gu oidha' bɨtaa'n tu' jix kavɨk jodai.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhuuk gu oidha' oo' maatai; gio ba' gu tɨkɨr jix dhaav bhaan tu' bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' kapbhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan; mi' dhɨr ka' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chuukug jix koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi bɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax gu oidha' cham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto bɨɨx jix duñia' cham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam saagi'ñ na ja'p jix duñia' bai'ñchu' gu tukgam cham ka' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk ka' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tanoolh cham tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu chio'ñ bɨɨx; gio ba' gu vaak cham; mi' dhɨr gu ux na tu ibai' oidha' u'va cham.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu vupui tu' cham jugi; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu' cham tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr kakneer ka't obhɨɨ'ñ cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ ka't kapbhai' gu ja'tkam gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu tanoolh; gio ba' cham gu kavɨk gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' bɨx tu jiim jugi gu ja'tkam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk ka' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha bɨɨx gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx kɨkbok cham; gio ba' dɨr gu vaas tɨɨt bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu ja'tkam cham tu' tattat; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai.
Jano' ba' ka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook daa'ñchu'nda' bɨx gu ja'tkam tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' yooxi'; na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ux na tu ibai' oidha' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' cham i'i suudai' u'va tu'; na gu' suulhgidha' jugi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu' cham tu' bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'; na gu' suudai' u'u.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't na ba' tu'; na gu'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x tu' ka' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham; gio ba' ka't mo'o tu' ka'.
Jano' ba' aajim bhaan tu' bɨx dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' nukadham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨi'ñchudat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu kai' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam obhɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu' bɨɨx bhiogi' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx uañi'ñ bɨx tu'x; gio ba' jix kavɨk jodai bhaan baakux bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ja'tkam nɨɨn cham.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui cham jix bhai'x tu' uañi'ñka' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jugi gu i'bhɨ gu vaakax gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham tu' kiicha' kai'ñ tu' bɨ'ñdhatu' tu' kakneer bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx ka'm vaak jodai tu' bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh bɨx gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' jugi gu i'bhɨ vook gu chuukug gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tu' bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x tu' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu vupui ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx xibhɨk na ba' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ baaso na ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham pai' dhuuk gu vaas tɨɨt gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' gu vupui ka't na ba' bɨɨx gu chio'ñ baaso na ba' bɨɨx gu mar na ba' bɨɨx mar u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' na ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨɨt na ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam; na gu' jugi uañi'ñ bɨx jix duñia' bɨɨx bhaamki'ñdha' tu' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga ua'ñix dhi' u'uan gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tɨɨgɨ' tas na jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu kai' dhi' dudua'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' bɨx gu Ejipto vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ko'kdai' bɨx cham u'uan dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu' bɨɨx ka'm tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam pai' jix duñia' na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' jix mui' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' cham tu' duu; gio ba' boopoya' bhaan gu oidha' na ba' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam dɨr gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' tattat gu jodai.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp tu' gu vaas tɨɨt jɨɨpi'ñka'; na tu' maa'n gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ jix bhai'x gu vupui ɨlhdha' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' na ja'p vupui bhaan tu' dhi' jix bhai'x gu tukaa' gu tanoolh cham gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh daipu'; gio ba' chɨkka jum duu gu xumai daipu'; mi' dhɨr chɨkka jum duu gu xibh ɨɨbhi'ñ gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx dhi' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gu bhóogɨt tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk; mi' dhɨr boopoya' obhɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Moab ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu oreb.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees jup tɨɨt bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' buupui bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Faraoon bɨx tu duukam bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui buimɨk kɨɨ'p.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix maa gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu vupui na ba' tu' maatɨt na ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' jajannulhi'ñ cham jix duñia' bhaan tu' bhaan tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' tu' suudai' u'va tu'; na ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' pai' jix buus gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan vupui bhaan no'ch na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Rubeen gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu duukam na ba' bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' chiñia' bopxi'ñ daraa bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' a'aalh gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu u'u bɨɨx ka'm jix buusñi gu suudai'.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨndak.
Na ba' na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu' ka't tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook na ja'p tattat gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' cham bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' buupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duiñxim gu u'u gu jodai jix toja jodai jix uam jodai namki' baidhak.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jiim gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' tatk.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi' mu'ai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bham; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ bhaan gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañchuda'; gio ba' va'k i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix duñia' gu chio'ñ bhaan bɨx mu'ai dhi' u'uan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bopxi'ñ gu Israeel na ba' cham bhai' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na jix bhaan ua'nak dhi' u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam aajim mi' dhɨr ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ɨlhdham oi'ñga'n na pai' dhuuk gu oidha' dudua'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' choiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' cham ka't tu' gu vaas matgɨm na ja'p gu Sodoma gu Gomorra gu Adma gu Seboim gu Jawatan Dios i'iich gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu oidha' daak gu ñi'ook i'iich.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tattat bɨɨx na pai' dhuuk jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Jawatan Dios cham matgɨm jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan dhi' gu oidha' na ba' bhaan ua'ñix dhi' u'uan.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bɨɨx i'iich jix gɨ' gu oidha' na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gu' na ba' no'ch na ba' gu Dios gu ma'nkam bɨɨx tas na ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk tu' daam bɨx dhi' tu'x gu ñi'ook mu'ai gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios tu' bhɨɨya' baas.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ma'nkam bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' jix maat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' nukadham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk dhi' u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga; na pai' dhuuk tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' cham gu tɨkɨr na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' chɨkka jix tɨ'ɨ no'ch gu tɨkɨr jix bhɨɨ na ba'.
Jano' ba' tu' baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' chɨkka gu ñi'ook no'ch gu gɨ' suudai' na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu bhóogɨt mia'n tu' gu ñi'ook gu chin gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' xoi'kam koi'm cham bhai'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt nukadham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk na ba' na jix do'ig gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oidha' na ba' bia'ka'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨɨda'; gio ba' cham gui'x jix duñia' gu tanoolh bhaan gu oidha' na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan na ba' bia'ka'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu oidha' koi'm gu ñi'ook mu'ai; na gu' gu ñi'ook pai' na gu' na jix do'ig tu' gu kai'.

Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jurtu'nka' bɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' tu' jix duñia' ɨɨbhi'ñ; na gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨndak; jano' ba' cham tu' kiicha' tu'.

Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Moisees gu Josuee ñiata bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' ba'k bɨɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat ka't tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' ka't bɨndak cham tu' kiicha' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh tu'.

Jano' ba' ua'na gu Moisees dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix maa jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx daraa gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv oi'ñga' gu Kabañas.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk daraibu' bɨx gu Israeel gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga vupui bhaan bɨx gu Israeel maatɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' koox bɨɨx tattat dhi' gu ja'tkam jix búup bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' tu' kua' tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr kiicha' tu' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' i'iich gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu vupui ka't; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook mui'x mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; na gu' cham jix duñia' gaagam dhi' ja'tkam na gu' cham gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vupui mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨx cham bhai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ua'ñ dhi' bhai' ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix dhaas gu chin na ba' dhi' bhai' ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook ñi'ookdham bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees ua'na dhi' bhai' ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' tu' jix duñia' bɨndak.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu gu Moisees gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga u'uan bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ookdham bhaan tu'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' kakasnira' uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' ua'tulhi'ñ jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx daraa bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook maatɨt dhi' gu ñi'ook mɨmɨim bhaan gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' mi' dhɨr koi'm gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' cham bhai' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees maatɨt bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook dhi' bhai' ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p dhuuk mamtuxi'ñdha'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p; mi' dhɨr na ja'p bhaan na ja'p gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vaas.
Na gu' na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu Roka gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' bɨx gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu'r matgɨm tu' na cham jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr jir bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ja'bsuna' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook jix maat.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam tu' cham gu taat tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu taat tu' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' kɨklhi'ñga'n tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duu na pai' dhuuk gu Altiisimo gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na gu' na gu' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' oidha' jix gaki pai' jix gaki gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' xikoolh jix duñia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook muuk jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' cham ka't bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu oidha' jix jugi gu i'bhɨ yooxi' tu' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam bɨ'ñdhatu' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bii'm kakneer bɨɨx ali' karneer gu chuukug gu Basaan; gio ba' gio chiiw bɨɨx tiriik; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jesurun; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu Roka tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham xixiibkam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook mia'n cham gu ñi'ook tattat.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Roka tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; gio ba' tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui ka't; na gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx cham gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duu bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gio bɨɨx gu ja'tkam cham gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu tai jix duñia' i'iich gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm jix dhaam suudai'; gio ba' gu oidha' gu i'bhɨ gu kakkavɨk.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x ka't bhiogi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daada'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook; gio ba' taatam gu vaakax gio bhaan bɨɨx gu ko'oi gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook; gio ba' biapma' na ja'p gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' oipichu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ chɨ'ñchoka'.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak bhaamki'ñdha' cham ka't cham ka't; gio ba' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mai' mamatdagɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook maa'n jix bhai'x gook mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x tu' gu Roka cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham dhagia'.
Na gu jodai' na jix uam cham na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Roka; gio ba' gu jodai' na jix uam obhɨɨ'ñ ka't.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sodoma gu Gomorra; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim namki'.
Jano' ba' gu ux na tu ibai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' cham no'ñ tu' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu Miia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tɨɨt jix duñia'; na gu' gu tanoolh mia'n jix bhai'x.
Na pai' dhuuk na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam tu duukam na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu kavɨk cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' na jix uam.
Na jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam makgɨrxi'ñdha' i'i suudai' u'va gu Lebaantense.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu' jix duñia' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' koi tu' duaka'; mi' dhɨr tu'; jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch jix duñia' gu novɨ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu novɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam gu kuchii gu novɨ ñi'ook na jir bhai' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr gu kuchii gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr koko'kam ɨɨbhidham bɨɨx bhaamki'ñdha'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp gu ja'tkam na gu' gu ɨ'ɨr tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook dhi' bhai' ñi'ook maatɨt gu ja'tkam gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ma'nkam jix dhaas tu duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' gu oidha'; gio ba' gu tanoolh bhaan gu oidha' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu kavɨk gu Abarim gu kavɨk gu Nebo gu oidha' gu Moab gu ñi'ook gu Jerikoo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Kanaan tu' gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' kuusdaidha' gu kavɨk jix tɨ'ɨ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix koi gu Aaroon xibhɨk gu kavɨk gu or ka't gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu suudai' gu Kades oidha' jix gaki gu Sin; na gu' cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' gu oidha'; gu' cham ba'k gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix bhai' aa' gu Moisees gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel va'k vaak jodai.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va gu Sinaii gu Seir gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu kavɨk gu Paraan suudai' u'va bɨɨx mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' jɨɨgi'ñdham; jano' ba' kɨɨ'n ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tai na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx jɨɨgi'ñdham gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr gio tɨɨt; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jakob.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Jesurun na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhidham gu ja'tkam bɨɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tai gu Rubeen cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't gu chio'ñ jɨɨ'ñdhidha'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu Judaa; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' gu noobh tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Lebii; gio ba' gu Tummim gu Urim bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ vaak zel gu Massa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu taat gu naan; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam tu' gu ma'nkam; jano' ba' nukadham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jakob ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi'ñi bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; na ba' cham pai' dhuuk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Benjamiin; gio ba' dha' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mia'n; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx tas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josee; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu tɨkɨr jix dhaam suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'bhɨ gu tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' nɨidhidha' bhaan mo'o gu Josee bhaan jix bhaan gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p maa'nkam mar gu jodai' na jix uam a'aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam tɨtda:―Aañ bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam mambhɨɨx gu Epraim dhi' ja'tkam gu Manasees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sabuloon; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sabuloon na pai' dhuuk; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Issakâr vaak zel.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu ja'tkam gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' makgɨrxi'ñdha' bɨx bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' oo'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Gad; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu jix duñia' gu Gad; mi' dhɨr na ja'p maavɨt gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n na gu' ka't suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨɨx gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dan; gio ba' gu Dan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maavɨt; mi' dhɨr dɨr gu Basaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Neptalii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x jix bhuup gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bia'ka' tas gei'ñ saagi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Aser; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aser gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr ka't gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bɨ'ñdhatu' tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' jix kavɨk jodai gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu tanoolh gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios gu Jesurun gɨ' kavɨk bhaan gu tɨkɨr na ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan tɨbaa'ñ bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook; gio ba' vupui bhaan tu' bhaamki'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu Destruye.
Jano' ba' gu Israeel suudai' buusñi gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' kai'ñ suudai' u'va; gio ba' gio gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel chɨkka na ja'p tu' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu kuchii gu ñi'ook obhɨɨ'ñ ka't tu' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Moisees vaak ja'tkam gu Moab gu kavɨk gu Nebo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pisga gu ñi'ook gu Jerikoo; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu oidha' gu Galaad bɨɨx ka'm gu Dan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Neptalii gu oidha' gu Epraim gu Manasees bɨx gu oidha' gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jerikoo kiicham gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x bɨɨx ka'm gu Soar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhi' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob bham; mi' dhɨr gu kai'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vupui gu' cham.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Moab jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Moab gu ñi'ook gu Betpeor; gio ba' tukga'n bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chamaam gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk jix koi; gio ba' gu vupui cham pai' dhuuk tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Moisees vaak ja'tkam gu Moab gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh suanda' gu Moisees.

Na gu' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun ka't jix bhuup gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ matda' na gu' gu Moisees ka't gu ñi'ook gu noobh bhaan; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duu na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Israeel na ja'p gu Moisees ka't gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨx buimɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhañ gu Jawatan Dios duñia' gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Faraoon bɨx tu duukam bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu Moisees gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel.
